description: Spectral and statistical features of the kHz vibration waveforms and the redundant process channels (raw_engine_hf_features): bearing defect tone, kurtosis, crest factor, core unbalance, oil system.

panels.title: Current vibration signature per engine
panels.description: Mean of each spectral feature over the last 5 minutes of the range (raw_engine_hf_features FINAL: one row per HF frame, i.e. per 1 Hz pulse). Kurtosis is ~3 for Gaussian vibration and rises with bearing impacts; the BPFO tone is the fan bearing outer-race defect frequency. Empty until the HF path is deployed. NaN/infinite values count as missing, as in the dbt staging model.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    engine_id AS `Engine`,
    any(engine_model) AS `Model`,
    count() AS `Frames (5 min)`,
    max(frame_start_ts) AS `Newest frame`,
    avg(if(isFinite(fan_amp_bpfo) AND fan_amp_bpfo >= 0, toFloat64(fan_amp_bpfo), NULL)) AS `Fan BPFO amplitude`,
    avg(if(isFinite(fan_kurtosis) AND fan_kurtosis >= 0, toFloat64(fan_kurtosis), NULL)) AS `Fan kurtosis`,
    avg(if(isFinite(fan_crest_factor) AND fan_crest_factor >= 0, toFloat64(fan_crest_factor), NULL)) AS `Fan crest factor`,
    avg(if(isFinite(core_amp_1x_n2) AND core_amp_1x_n2 >= 0, toFloat64(core_amp_1x_n2), NULL)) AS `Core 1xN2 amplitude`,
    avg(if(isFinite(fan_band_energy_hf) AND fan_band_energy_hf >= 0, toFloat64(fan_band_energy_hf), NULL)) AS `Fan HF band energy`,
    avg(if(mapContains(process_means, 'OIL_QTY_A'), if(isFinite(process_means['OIL_QTY_A']) AND process_means['OIL_QTY_A'] >= 0, toFloat64(process_means['OIL_QTY_A']), NULL), NULL)) AS `Oil quantity`,
    avg(if(mapContains(process_means, 'OIL_DP_A'), if(isFinite(process_means['OIL_DP_A']) AND process_means['OIL_DP_A'] >= 0, toFloat64(process_means['OIL_DP_A']), NULL), NULL)) AS `Oil filter dP`,
    avg(if(mapContains(process_means, 'SCAV_T_A'), if(isFinite(process_means['SCAV_T_A']), toFloat64(process_means['SCAV_T_A']), NULL), NULL)) AS `Scavenge oil temp`,
    avg(if(isFinite(egt_ab_split) AND egt_ab_split >= 0, toFloat64(egt_ab_split), NULL)) AS `EGT A/B split`
FROM raw_engine_hf_features FINAL
WHERE frame_start_ts > $__toTime - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
  AND frame_start_ts <= $__toTime
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY engine_id
ORDER BY engine_id

panels.title: Bearing & rotor signatures (5-minute rolling means per engine lifecycle, as the RUL model sees them)
Fan bearing defect tone (BPFO amplitude)
panels.description: Amplitude of the fan bearing outer-race defect frequency (bpfo_order x N1) in the fan-frame velocity spectrum. Grows roughly with w^3..w^4, strongest for BEARING_DEGRADATION. 5-minute rolling mean per engine lifecycle (the contract's fan_amp_bpfo_mean_5m).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(frame_start_ts) AS time,
    engine_id,
    argMax(mean_5m, frame_start_ts) AS fan_amp_bpfo_mean_5m
FROM
(
    SELECT
        engine_id,
        frame_start_ts,
        avg(if(isFinite(fan_amp_bpfo) AND fan_amp_bpfo >= 0, toFloat64(fan_amp_bpfo), NULL)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY engine_id, lifecycle_id
            ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp64Milli(frame_start_ts)
            RANGE BETWEEN 300000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS mean_5m
    FROM raw_engine_hf_features FINAL
    WHERE frame_start_ts >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
      AND frame_start_ts <= $__toTime
      AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
)
WHERE frame_start_ts >= $__fromTime
GROUP BY time, engine_id
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Impulsiveness peaks, spectral shape & HF data health
Fan kurtosis frame-level peaks
panels.description: Highest per-frame fan kurtosis in each time bucket. The 5-minute means above smooth single bearing impact bursts away; the peaks show them.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(frame_start_ts) AS time,
    engine_id,
    max(if(isFinite(fan_kurtosis) AND fan_kurtosis >= 0, toFloat64(fan_kurtosis), NULL)) AS fan_kurtosis_max
FROM raw_engine_hf_features FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(frame_start_ts)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY time, engine_id
ORDER BY time

panels.title: HF frames per minute
panels.description: Feature rows (one per HF frame) landed per engine and minute, by frame time. Each operating engine emits one frame per 1 Hz tick, so a steady engine sits near 60.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(frame_start_ts) AS time,
    engine_id,
    count() * 60 / $__interval_s AS frames_per_minute
FROM raw_engine_hf_features FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(frame_start_ts)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY time, engine_id
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Fan spool speed N1
panels.description: Mean fan (low-pressure) spool speed per bucket from the HF frames: the reference of the order analysis (the BPFO tone sits at bpfo_order x N1 / 60 Hz). The core speed N2 is the 1 Hz rpm.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(frame_start_ts) AS time,
    engine_id,
    avg(if(isFinite(n1_rpm) AND n1_rpm >= 0, toFloat64(n1_rpm), NULL)) AS n1_rpm_avg
FROM raw_engine_hf_features FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(frame_start_ts)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY time, engine_id
ORDER BY time
